content: This paper introduces a novel methodology for performing simultaneous feature selection and classification of high-dimensional longitudinal data, specifically tailored for categorical outcomes. By integrating functional principal components with an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm, the approach efficiently handles complex datasets where the number of features exceeds the number of observations.
